summary: Whitestone REIT filed an 8-K disclosing shareholder lawsuits challenging proxy disclosures for its planned merger with an Ares affiliate pursuant to a merger agreement dated April 8, 2026. Under the deal, Whitestone will be acquired by Merger Sub (AREG Wizard Intermediate LP), with the Operating Partnership merging into a separate entity. Shareholders will vote at a special meeting on July 9, 2026. Terms (price per share, premium) are not specified in this filing. The board recommends the merger; no advisors named. The lawsuits seek supplemental disclosures. Watch for possible settlement requiring added proxy disclosures or a vote delay, though the schedule remains tight.
